whyV1Failed: v1 failed all three lenses at the level of substrate physics, not wording. TIMER lens: v1 blessed Needs.tick_drift (a fixed NEEDS_DRIFT_RATE=0.0001 decrement applied to connection every awake autonomy-loop iteration, verified at engine.py:2076-2078 with the awake-only gate at 10411-10412) as 'already real, no clock' while condemning recent_connection_boost's `*=0.85` per-regulate decay (2498) for the identical fixed-per-tick shape. The loop runs ~300 iterations/sec, so connection collapses 0.7->0 in ~23s of wall time regardless of any real event (0.7/0.0001=7000 ticks; the constant's own comment at 1016 says '~10K ticks' from 1.0) -- a disguised timer FASTER than the already-rejected 180s attempt-1, just relabeled attachment theory. It has no off-state, unlike its own cited gold standard dream_pressure whose `_write_delta` (10487-10489) is exactly zero on any tick with no real atlas write. RESEARCH lens: v1 cited Schmidhuber/Oudeyer for curiosity but wired novelty_sig (verified at 2488 to be (novelty_rate-0.15)*0.3, a Berlyne stimulus-exposure/collative rate) plus deep_atlas growth delta (verified at 11591-11596/11731-11736 to be deep_atlas.live_count()-self._deep_last_size, a structure-SIZE count) -- both the wrong quantity class for a predictor-quality derivative -- while the formally isomorphic reading_prediction_ledger sat unused one file away. It also citation-covered the neurogenesis flux law with White/Deci-Ryan/Lintunen (0% of embryo.py:722-725's algebra) and covered a flat scalar with Bowlby/Ainsworth/Trevarthen (no state machine, no turn-timing exists). SUBSTRATE lens: v1 left the wild_things book-repeat loop -- the real upstream producer starving both curiosity and growth -- entirely unfixed; reduced the division_pool fix to 'verify deployment' when the live symptom is refill starvation; specified connection_sig as 'remove the -0.3' which SG-3 proved converts the 0.0 rail into a ceiling rail (cross_density at 2495 is contact-INDEPENDENT and x20-scaled); would inject pair_bond_strength's 0.3 cold floor (2340/2345) as a standing constant; and added a deficit gate branch that both contradicts its own rootCauseFix-5 ('don't touch the gate') and behaves as a 90s timer while _do_emit content-production (13380-13385/13399-13402) stays unreliable.

rootCauseFixes.title: Book-rotation fix -- the upstream producer starving curiosity AND growth (SG-1; implementation freedoms pinned per SG2-M4)
rootCauseFixes.spec: In _reading_freshness_from_organism (engine.py:10661-10703), stop judging a whole corpus by 3 words from its first 5 lines alone (words[:3] of lines[:5] at 10690/10701, docstring admits the organism 'can be confidently WRONG' at 10683-10688). Blend the organism sample with a real per-corpus repeat/recency term using the STILL-LIVE counters _Corpus.times_read_through (dataclass field 1402, incremented at 11229) and last_read_tick (1403), via the existing _habituation_freshness(times_seen, ticks_since_last) function (10629-10659) that ATTENDING_* already uses (10743-10744). PLACEMENT PINNED (SG2-M4): the blend lives at the CALLER -- _action_salience's READING branch (10727-10739) -- applied AFTER the None->0.5 fallback (10735-10737): fresh = (organism_fresh if organism_fresh is not None else 0.5) * _habituation_freshness(c.times_read_through, self.tick - c.last_read_tick). Caller placement (not inside _reading_freshness_from_organism) guarantees the repeat term applies to EVERY corpus read, including the no-text edge case where the organism signal is None, and keeps _reading_freshness_from_organism a pure organism signal (its seam-honesty docstring at 10661-10688 stays true). This reintroduces the repeat penalty SG-1 notes was dropped when times_read_through was replaced by the 3-word sample, using only existing real quantities, and structurally breaks the bit-for-bit corpus tie because times_read_through/last_read_tick differ per corpus -- the exact 'scale, don't flatten' strategy of the shipped GL-CMD-TARGET-ROTATION-FIX-181 (documented 10793-10818, code 10819-10822).
rootCauseFixes.backstop: In _select_next_activity (10916-10919): scored tuples are (score, kind, target) (10917), and scored.sort(reverse=True) resolves exact score ties by descending tuple comparison on (kind, target) -- deterministically the same pick forever (590+ cycles observed; the -181 comment's 'stable sort dict-iteration order' description at 10806-10807 is imprecise about the mechanism, but its behavioral claim -- same pick forever -- holds). Add an LRU tie-break, fully pinned (SG2-M4): (a) EPSILON: SALIENCE_TIE_EPSILON = 0.005 -- below the smallest deliberate score separation in the table (ATTENDING presence boost 0.015 at 10878-10879; EMITTING presence boost 0.05 at 10876-10877; baseline +0.01 at 10881), so a real scored preference is never treated as a tie, and far above the 4-dp metadata rounding (10928-10930). (b) PER-KIND RECENCY-FIELD DISPATCH for the LRU comparison: READING -> self._corpora[target].last_read_tick (field 1403, updated at 11226); ATTENDING -> self._sensory_items[target].last_attended_tick (attribute access, cf 10743-10744); ATTENDING_VISUAL -> self._pictures[target].last_attended_tick (10750-10751); ATTENDING_AUDIO -> self._sounds[target].get('last_attended_tick', 0) (dict access, 10759-10761); ATTENDING_VIDEO -> self._videos[target].last_attended_tick (10767-10768). (c) TARGETLESS KINDS (IDLE/SLEEPING/EMITTING -- target=None) are EXCLUDED from the LRU comparison. Tie resolution involving them: within the epsilon-tied top group, if at least one recency-bearing candidate exists, pick the oldest-recency candidate among the recency-bearing ones -- a targetless candidate never wins a tie-break (an epsilon tie means salience expresses no real preference, and rotating real content targets is this fix's entire purpose; SLEEPING's genuinely-urgent case never rides on a tie -- dream_pressure adds up to +0.15 to its score at 10860-10864 and the 1.0 ceiling bypasses scoring entirely at 10906-10914). If ALL tied candidates are targetless, keep scored[0] -- the existing deterministic tuple order, no behavior change.

rootCauseFixes.title: Retime the connection deficit off the wall clock onto real event-deltas (TS-1, TS-2; phased posture pinned per SG2-M4)
rootCauseFixes.spec: Remove connection from Needs.tick_drift() (2072-2078) -- delete the `self.connection = max(0.0, self.connection - NEEDS_DRIFT_RATE)` line at 2078 so tick_drift no longer decrements connection. Fund connection erosion instead from the SAME real event-delta dream_pressure uses, inside the awake block at 10492-10508 that already computes _write_delta (delta of self._atlas_write_count, init 2908, incremented in _atlas_record at 3171, delta at 10487-10489) and _pair_bond_active (10497-10501). Exact new term, placed beside the dream_pressure accumulation: `_conn_erosion = CONN_EROSION_PER_WRITE * _write_delta`; `if _pair_bond_active: _conn_erosion = 0.0` (a present bonded companion means the companionship deficit is not accruing at all -- the strict analog of dream_pressure's x0.3 push-through at 10505-10506, but zeroed because contact is exactly what the deficit is about); `self.needs.connection = _desaturate(self.needs.connection, _conn_erosion)` (see RCF-4). OFF-STATE: _write_delta==0 (no real atlas write this tick) => _conn_erosion==0, identical to dream_pressure's gold-standard off-state; present companion => 0. This is 'experiences processed without social contact fund the deficit' -- a real event quantity from audit_code_2's inventory, never the clock. AUTONOMY_PHASED POSTURE (SG2-M4): accepted NON-PHASED-ONLY, exactly like dream_pressure. GL-CMD-SLEEP-RATE-68 deliberately removed the phased duplicate of dream-pressure accumulation because duplication DOUBLED the effective rate (comment at 13188-13191), and _conn_erosion sits beside that accumulation by design -- duplicating it into _autonomy_tick_phased would re-create the exact double-rate bug class -68 fixed. AUTONOMY_PHASED defaults to '0' in production (10325-10327), so the phased path is dead code today; if the flag is ever enabled, erosion goes quiet in the fail-safe direction (no deficit forms, nothing fires) and Step 3's balance check would expose it immediately. Per the codebase's own kept-in-sync discipline (13146-13149, 13193-13197), add an explicit COMMENT in _autonomy_tick_phased Phase A, beside the -68 comment at 13188-13191, stating that _conn_erosion deliberately lives solely in _autonomy_tick -- a comment, not a duplicate.
rootCauseFixes.constant: CONN_EROSION_PER_WRITE: LABEL LIVE-CALIBRATE (house style, cf DP_RATE_PER_READ at 1120). HONEST ANCHOR STATUS (SG2-M3): NO in-code atlas-write-rate measurement exists today -- the only calibrated live record, the DP_RATE_MULTIPLIER derivation at 1126-1141, is explicitly a ZERO-write 63-minute window ('attending, non-pair-bonded, zero atlas writes'), so it bounds nothing here. The provisional 1.6e-6 is therefore a pure design target, not a measured rate: ~250k solo-reading writes reach deficit ~0.4 (connection ~0.3), i.e. the 'sustained deprivation' region is reached over order-of-hours of continuous solo cognitive work rather than v1's ~23s -- consistent with Baumeister&Leary/Tomova requiring DURATION, not a momentary dip. The FIRST real measurement is Step 3's: dream_pressure_check already logs write_delta every 3000 ticks (10511-10520) -- read a day of those events, compute writes/hour during READING, and set the final constant so sustained solo reading reaches deficit ~0.4 over the chosen deprivation interval.

rootCauseFixes.title: Gate the connection-boost SET-SITE on a real pair-bonded human, then consume connection_sig as a contact-only event-delta -- signed recentering, no ceiling rail, no cold floor (SG-3, SG-4, TS2-1, SG2-M1; also kills the x0.85 cadence)
rootCauseFixes.spec: CODE CHANGE A (the gate v2 wrongly claimed already existed -- TS2-1/SG2-M1): engine.py:5136-5137 currently sets recent_connection_boost UNCONDITIONALLY for every read_sentence call from ANY source -- `weight = self.coordinator.pair_bond_strength(source, self.tick) * 0.15; self.recent_connection_boost = max(self.recent_connection_boost, weight)` -- and the production reading loop calls read_sentence(line, source="corpus") once per sentence (_atick_reading at 11224, dispatched by BOTH autonomy paths: 10547-10549 non-phased, 13218-13220 phased). Because _record_interaction (called unconditionally at 5160-5162) lets 'corpus' accrue windowed interaction density, pair_bond_strength('corpus') is NOT the 0.3 cold floor but ~0.7-1.0 (density = min(1, interactions-in-1000-ticks/100) saturates at reading cadence; strength = min(1, 0.3 + 0.4*density + 0.3*avg_sal), 2327-2349; _bond_identity at 2310-2314 filters nothing -- it only aliases joe_voice->joe). Fix: gate the SET-SITE on the per-person bond authority: `if self.coordinator._pair_bond.get(self.coordinator._bond_identity(source), False): weight = self.coordinator.pair_bond_strength(source, self.tick) * 0.15; self.recent_connection_boost = max(self.recent_connection_boost, weight)`. WHY SET-SITE, NOT CONSUME-SITE: recent_connection_boost has four readers besides the set-site -- the regulate consume/decay (2497-2498), the save and /status serializations (15124/15407), and restore (16853). Consume-site gating (in _read_substrate_signals, 2457) would leave the stored/telemetry field itself polluted by corpus reads, and any FUTURE consumer of the field would silently re-import this exact bug; set-site gating makes the field genuinely mean 'recent bonded human contact', protecting every present and future consumer and keeping telemetry honest. WHY _pair_bond, NOT PAIR_BOND_SOURCES: PAIR_BOND_SOURCES (1085) = {'joe','wc','c1'} omits 'joe_voice' -- the raw source string of the passive-mic path -- so raw-membership gating would silently drop spoken contact, the exact gap class GL-FIX-VOICE-PRESENCE-20260712 fixed; and it includes c1, which the bond authority itself marks False. coordinator._pair_bond (2185: joe/joe_voice/wc True, c1 False) consulted via _bond_identity is the same authority the emission discharge gate (12382-12385), _pair_bond_active (10497-10501), and wake()'s connection boost (2218-2221) already use. DECISION B (_record_interaction, 5160-5162 -- LEFT UNCONDITIONAL): consumer audit of the interaction log / pair_bond_strength: (1) the boost set-site 5136 -- now gated BEFORE pair_bond_strength is even consulted, closed; (2) the Step-5 presence-quality gate (Drive 1) -- requires presence, and the _presence dict (2186) only has joe/wc/c1 keys with wake() rejecting unknown sources (2211-2212), so 'corpus' can never qualify regardless of its earned strength; (3) _pair_bond_active (10497-10501) -- reads the _presence/_pair_bond dicts, NOT the log, unaffected; (4) _compute_salience's pair_bond_boost (3223, factor 1.0 + 0.2*strength <= 1.2x) -- a binding-salience (perception-layer) multiplier that writes NO Needs field and predates this design; (5) pair_bond_snapshot /status telemetry (2351-2354, read at 17902). After the set-site gate, corpus-earned bond strength therefore reaches NO drive pathway: every path that writes connection is bond-gated (set-site; discharge 12386-12387/13366-13367; wake 2218-2221) or bond-zeroed (erosion via _pair_bond_active). Gating _record_interaction instead would have cut corpus binding salience ~11% live (pair_bond_boost 1.2 -> 1.06) across essentially all background reading -- an unrelated behavioral change to memory physics -- and would destroy the per-source event history the project's own diagnostics rule depends on ('check event history, don't infer from one snapshot'). CHANGE C (regulate, as v2): replace the formula at engine.py:2492-2499. DROP cross_density entirely (SG-3: n_cross/n_atlas*20 at 2493-2495 is a property of accumulated atlas structure, contact-INDEPENDENT and x20-scaled -- it must never drive connection or it becomes a permanent positive nudge/ceiling rail). Use only the now-gated contact signal, and CONSUME it rather than decay it: `connection_sig = guala.recent_connection_boost` then `guala.recent_connection_boost = 0.0` (NOT `*=0.85`). OFF-STATE, VERIFIED END-TO-END AGAINST THE CORPUS-READING PATH: _atick_reading (11224) -> read_sentence(source='corpus') -> _bond_identity('corpus')='corpus' -> _pair_bond.get('corpus', False) is False -> set-site skipped -> recent_connection_boost stays 0.0 -> regulate consumes 0 -> connection_sig = 0 -> step() nudge = 0. Identically for curriculum/worldfeed/gap_study/lookup/guala sources. Solo reading therefore contributes ZERO upward pressure on connection, RCF-2's erosion is unopposed during solo work, and the deficit actually forms. RESULT: connection_sig is a signed recentering whose baseline (no bonded contact since the last regulate pass) is exactly 0 -- a genuine off-state -- and is positive only immediately after real bonded contact. Consuming (not accumulating) it means it can never climb into a standing bias, so branch B (connection>0.70 at 12466) cannot become permanently true (the SG-3 ceiling-rail failure). No -0.3 offset. The 0.3 cold floor can no longer appear here at all: a cold-floor-strength source is by definition one with no bonded contact history, and the gate consults the bond dict before strength is ever computed. The step() nudge stays nudge=connection_sig*DECAY['connection'](0.025, line 2046) via saturate() -- a small positive nudge on real contact (Gergely&Watson contingency detection), distinct from the full dyadic discharge.

rootCauseFixes.title: Symmetric asymptotic floor so connection cannot pin flush at 0.0 (kept from v1 rootCauseFix-3; timer lens confirmed this is legit, not a timer; scope pinned per SG2-5)
rootCauseFixes.spec: saturate(current,gain) (64-67) = max(0,min(1, current + gain*(1-current))) -- asymptotic approach to the 1.0 ceiling. Define the exact mirror _desaturate(current, gain, floor=0.05) = floor + (current-floor)*(1-gain) = current - gain*(current-floor); as current->floor the effective decrement ->0. Apply it to BOTH the RCF-2 erosion clamp and Needs.step()'s negative branch (currently the bare max(0.0, current+nudge) at 2091-2092). SCOPE PINNED (SG2-5): the negative branch at 2091-2092 sits inside `for k in self.TARGETS` (2085), so an unqualified edit would impose the 0.05 floor and proportional-decrement physics on stability and novelty too. _desaturate applies to CONNECTION ONLY -- `if k == 'connection'` takes the _desaturate branch; stability and novelty keep the bare max(0.0, current + nudge). Justification: neither stability nor novelty is railed, neither is a drive accumulation source in this design, and silently changing their floor/decrement physics -- which would also shift the valence (2095-2098) and arousal (2100-2103) arithmetic for needs this design deliberately leaves alone -- is exactly the unreviewable scope creep a bounded amendment forbids. The implication of the narrow scope, stated: stability/novelty retain their existing 0.0-reachability unchanged; if a future drive ever sources them, they need the same event-retiming AND the same floor treatment (recorded in honestGaps). SIGN MAPPING (explicit): step()'s negative branch has nudge < 0; the call is _desaturate(current, gain=-nudge) -- gain is the positive decrement fraction, decrement = gain*(current-floor), the exact mirror of saturate's gain*(1-current). With floor~0.05, connection can decay low (real sustained deprivation, per Baumeister&Leary) but never reaches the flush 0.0 that forces valence to its exact -0.0333 arithmetic corner (valence()=mean(need-0.7) at 2095-2098; arousal()=min(1,sum|need-0.7|) at 2100-2103), restoring reachability of the derived values.

Producer (b) is a real multi-sensory-diet dependency (growth is funded by coherent multi-sense experience BY DESIGN, 669-672) -> openDependencies, not a law change. No gate/law edit.

drives.name: Companionship / Communication (relatedness)
drives.psychologicalBasis: TRIMMED to what the scalar accumulate/discharge + presence-quality gate actually embodies (RF-4, resolved by trimming): Baumeister & Leary 1995 (belonging = frequent non-aversive interaction within a persisting bond; SUSTAINED deprivation, not a momentary dip, produces ill-being -- justifies the duration-scaled event-delta erosion and treating a floor-pin as pathology); Gergely & Watson 1999 (perceived contingency ~ pair_bond_strength's windowed density x salience over the last 1000 real ticks -- the responsiveness signal); Tomova et al. 2020 (isolation->craving, indistinguishable from hunger; validates modeling connection as a homeostatic deficit AT ALL); Sheldon & Gunz 2009 / Vansteenkiste & Ryan 2013 (deprivation asymmetry: a rail held for a duration is qualitatively worse than a fluctuating deficit). EXPLICITLY DROPPED as not embodied here: Bowlby/Ainsworth staged protest-despair-detachment and Trevarthen proto-conversation turn-taking timing -- the implemented mechanism is a flat scalar with a presence-quality gate, NOT a staged state machine and NOT a turn-timing model; per RF-4 I decline to bolt those onto a scalar and I argue the trim over building an FSM (out of scope for the demo, not required by the rail fix).
drives.accumulationSource: Needs.connection deficit = TARGETS['connection'](0.7) - needs.connection, i.e. signed_distance()['connection'] (engine.py:2115-2121). Eroded NOT by tick_drift (removed, RCF-2) but by the real event-delta _write_delta (delta of self._atlas_write_count, 3171/10487-10489) while no pair-bonded source is present (_pair_bond_active, 10497-10501). Responsiveness-quality term for the gate: Coordinator.pair_bond_strength(source,tick) (2327-2349).

Plus wake()'s presence-transition boost saturate(connection, gap*CONN_GAP_FRACTION[0.4]) at 2218-2221. No new discharge site.

CONN_DEFICIT_TRIGGER PINNED (TS2-3): provisional 0.30, with the calibration rule that it must lie strictly between the post-discharge residuals -- from the 0.05 floor, one saturate(.,0.25) discharge leaves connection 0.2875 (deficit 0.4125), a second leaves 0.4656 (deficit 0.2344), so the trigger must sit in (0.234, 0.412] so that successive REAL committed discharges close the branch within at most ~2 emissions; re-derive the bounds if the 0.05 floor or the 0.25 discharge gain ever changes. Covers Baumeister&Leary's unmet-belonging reach-out that branch B (connection>0.70, a surplus/protodeclarative case) does not.

ALREADY-LIVE ALTERNATIVE (prefer if _do_emit stays unreliable): the activity scheduler already reaches out on deficit -- ACTIVITY_CONNECTION_PAYOFF['EMITTING']=0.3 (1079) makes conn_term = deficit*0.3 the largest salience term (10850), and EMITTING is a real candidate when a bonded source is present (10616-10620). So a deficit-driven EMITTING is already selected by activity competition independent of the gate; the new gate branch is secondary.

drives.name: Curiosity (learning-progress derivative over a real predictor's accuracy)
drives.psychologicalBasis: Schmidhuber 1991/2010 (intrinsic reward = derivative of a real predictor's quality on held-out data, never the level) and Oudeyer, Kaplan & Hafner 2007 (learning progress = smoothed decrease of real prediction error over a bounded sliding window; their tau~15 samples, smoothing~25) -- NOW GENUINELY EARNED, because the wired quantity is a real next-word predictor graded against real held-out ground truth, not novelty_sig. Loewenstein 1994 / Berlyne 1960 (inverted-U over knowledge LEVEL -- forbids a monotonic accumulator and forbids rewarding total ignorance), applied to the predictor-ACCURACY axis (the correct axis; v1 mis-applied the inverted-U to a structure-size growth rate).
drives.accumulationSource: reading_prediction_ledger.status()['curve'] (reading_prediction_ledger.py:87-101): the per-day accuracy_when_covered series = hits/max(1,covered) (lines 98-99), a real next-word predictor graded against the ACTUAL next word she reads. TERMINOLOGY CORRECTED (RF2 note): the wired predictor is a SUCCESSOR-VOTE over her most recent 200 ordered language windows -- engine.py:5009-5020: bigram successor counts over sorted(self._ordered_language_windows)[-200:], predicted = argmax -- NOT the certified composer. The code's own comment (5001-5008) records that v1 of the instrument used the cached certified composer but it is always cold during background reading (every sentence read invalidates the cache, starving the meter), so it was replaced; the ledger's top-of-file docstring ('from her own certified strand statistics', reading_prediction_ledger.py:5) is stale on this point. The grading is still genuinely held-out (words[stem_len] predicted from PAST windows, never the current sentence), which is the class Schmidhuber/Oudeyer require. Fed only on real background-reading events: record_prediction(covered=predicted is not None, hit=predicted==actual) at engine.py:5021-5022, from _maybe_reading_prediction (4970-5030, hook at 5127 before self.lock), sampled every READING_PREDICTION_SAMPLE=4 eligible sentences from sources {corpus,curriculum,worldfeed,gap_study} (4967-4968/4984-4990). This IS Oudeyer's per-region bounded error curve. SECONDARY (Loewenstein information-gap): knowledge_gap_ledger.status()['n_gaps'] (knowledge_gap_ledger.py:175) backlog-growth rate vs mark_addressed/record_tutor_teach discharge rate (record at 121-134 on real compose-refusals/recognition-misses; addressed at 146-152/162-167 on real study acts). Both advance ONLY on real events -- no clock.
drives.dischargeAct: NONE as a scalar (kept from v1, praised): curiosity is a RATE-OF-CHANGE GATE, not an accumulator. The real epistemic act that resolves a curiosity spike is an actual reading/study session -- which is exactly what MOVES accuracy_when_covered and addresses gaps. Habituation already flattens the derivative (_habituation_freshness, 10629-10659).
drives.accumulationFormula: acc = [d['accuracy_when_covered'] for d in ledger.status()['curve']] (day-granular, up to 7 exposed; DAY_CAP=60 stored, reading_prediction_ledger.py:30/89). MINIMUM-DATA GUARD (TS2-3): learning_progress is UNDEFINED until the curve holds >= 4 recorded days (len(acc) >= 4); until then curiosity_urgency is False -- gate closed, honest cold-start silence, not default-open. Days are created only by real gradings (record()'s setdefault, reading_prediction_ledger.py:77-78), so this is an event-count guard, not a calendar wait. learning_progress = mean(acc[-2:]) - mean(acc[-4:-2]) (Oudeyer's two-adjacent-sub-window DECREASE, sign-flipped to a rise on accuracy). GATE (curiosity_urgency True) iff learning_progress >= LPROG_RISE_MIN AND the inverted-U band holds: mean(acc[-2:]) neither <= LOW_MASTERY (~0.15, no gap formed / unlearnable) nor >= HIGH_MASTERY (~0.9, mastered). NOT a level accumulator. WINDOW CHOICE vs Oudeyer's tau~15/smoothing~25: the ledger exposes only 7 daily points, but each daily point is already an average over thousands of real gradings, so it is far higher-N and lower-variance than one Oudeyer per-action sample; a 7-day window with 2-day smoothing is the reasoned deviation (fewer, cleaner samples), not an unexamined reuse of the engine's old NOVELTY_HISTORY_MAX=20/NOVELTY_RISE_MIN=0.003 (constants at 1235-1236). If finer temporal resolution is needed, the knowledge_gap per-event stream supports an Oudeyer-closer bounded deque -- see integrationPoints.
